title: On the Optimisation Landscape of Overparameterised Weighted MMD
abstract: arXiv:2610.19861v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the optimisation landscape of the maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) over weighted atomic measures. For the one-dimensional Gaussian kernel, we show that, for any compactly supported target distribution, sufficiently many particles ensure that every local minimum has arbitrarily small MMD. Moreover, any stationary point whose MMD remains bounded away from zero is unstable under an unweighted gradient flow over the particle locations. These results hold both when the weights are constrained to the simplex, and when they are unconstrained but optimised at each step. When the target is itself finitely supported, we further strengthen this result: beyond an explicit particle threshold, there are no spurious local minima, and every spurious stationary point is unstable. To our knowledge, these are the first finite-particle overparameterisation guarantees of their kind for weighted MMD optimisation.

translated_title: 关于过参数化加权最大均值差异（MMD）的优化景观研究
translated_abstract: 我们研究了加权原子测度上最大均值差异（MMD）的优化景观。对于一维高斯核，我们证明，对于任何紧支撑的目标分布，足够多的粒子可以确保每个局部极小值都具有任意小的MMD。此外，任何MMD仍然远离零的驻点，在粒子位置的无权重梯度流下都是不稳定的。这些结果既适用于权重被约束在单纯形上的情况，也适用于权重不受约束但每一步都被优化的情况。当目标分布本身是有限支撑时，我们进一步加强了这一结果：超过一个明确的粒子数量阈值后，不存在虚假局部极小值，且每个虚假驻点都是不稳定的。据我们所知，这些是针对加权MMD优化的首类有限粒子过参数化保证。
tldr: 该论文首次为加权MMD优化提供了有限粒子的过参数化保证，证明对于一维高斯核，在粒子数量足够多时所有局部极小值都具有任意小的MMD，且所有虚假驻点均不稳定。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first finite-particle overparameterisation guarantees for weighted MMD optimisation, showing that for the one-dimensional Gaussian kernel, sufficiently many particles ensure every local minimum has arbitrarily small MMD and all spurious stationary points are unstable.
